items.source: Create a new TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy。

items.source: Delegates to DataSourceUtils for automatically participating in thread-bound transactions, for example managed by DataSourceTransactionManager. getConnection calls and close calls on returned Connections will behave properly within a transaction, i.e. always operate on the transactional Connection. If not within a transaction, normal DataSource behavior applies.
items.translation: 委托给DataSourceUtils以自动参与线程绑定的事务，例如由DataSourceTransactionManager管理的事务。getConnection 调用和对返回的 Connection 的close 调用将在事务内正确执行，即始终在事务性 Connection 上操作。如果不在事务中，则应用正常的 DataSource 行为。

items.source: Make sure that TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy is the outermost DataSource of a chain of DataSource proxies/adapters. TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy can delegate either directly to the target connection pool or to some intermediary proxy/adapter like LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy or UserCredentialsDataSourceAdapter.
items.translation: 确保 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy 是 DataSource 代理/适配器链中最外层的 DataSource。 TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy 可以委托给目标连接池，或者委托给某些中间代理/适配器，例如 LazyConnectionDataSourceProxy 或 UserCredentialsDataSourceAdapter。

items.source: NOTE: This DataSource proxy needs to return wrapped Connections (which implement the ConnectionProxy interface) in order to handle close calls properly. Use Wrapper.unwrap(Class) to retrieve the native JDBC Connection.
items.translation: 注意：此 DataSource 代理需要返回包装后的连接（实现ConnectionProxy接口），以便正确处理关闭调用。请使用Wrapper.unwrap(Class)获取原生 JDBC 连接。

items.source: Data access code that should remain unaware of Spring's data access support can work with this proxy to seamlessly participate in Spring-managed transactions. Note that the transaction manager, for example DataSourceTransactionManager, still needs to work with the underlying DataSource, not with this proxy.
items.translation: 应使数据访问代码对 Spring 的数据访问支持保持无感知，该代理可使其无缝参与由 Spring 管理的事务。请注意，事务管理器（例如 DataSourceTransactionManager）仍需与底层 DataSource 配合工作，而非与此代理配合。

items.source: The default implementation returns true for all standard cases. This can be overridden through the "reobtainTransactionalConnections" flag, which enforces a non-fixed target Connection within an active transaction. Note that non-transactional access will always use a fixed Connection.
items.translation: 默认实现对于所有标准情况均返回 true。这可以通过"reobtainTransactionalConnections"标志进行覆盖，该标志强制在活跃事务中使用非固定目标 Connection。请注意，非事务性访问将始终使用固定 Connection。

items.source:
This proxy allows data access code to work with the plain JDBC API and still
participate in Spring-managed transactions, similar to JDBC code in a Jakarta EE/JTA
environment. However, if possible, use Spring's DataSourceUtils, JdbcTemplate or
JDBC operation objects to get transaction participation even without a proxy for
the target DataSource, avoiding the need to define such a proxy in the first place.
items.translation: 此代理允许数据访问代码使用纯 JDBC API 工作，同时参与 Spring 管理的事务，类似于 Jakarta EE/JTA 环境中的 JDBC 代码。然而，如果可能，请使用 Spring 的 `DataSourceUtils`、`JdbcTemplate` 或 JDBC 操作对象来获取事务参与，即使目标 DataSource 没有代理也是如此，从而避免首先定义此类代理的需要。

items.source:
As a further effect, using a transaction-aware DataSource will apply remaining
transaction timeouts to all created JDBC (Prepared/Callable)Statement. This means
that all operations performed through standard JDBC will automatically participate
in Spring-managed transaction timeouts.
items.translation: 此外，使用支持事务的 DataSource 会将剩余的事务超时时间应用于所有创建的 JDBC（预编译/可调用）Statement。这意味着通过标准 JDBC 执行的所有操作将自动参与由 Spring 管理的事务超时。

items.source:
The default is "true". Specify "false" to immediately obtain a target
Connection when a transaction-aware Connection handle is retrieved.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。指定 "false" 可在获取事务感知连接句柄时立即获得目标 Connection。

items.source:
The default is "false". Specify "true" to reobtain transactional
Connections for every call on the Connection proxy; this is advisable
on JBoss if you hold on to a Connection handle across transaction boundaries.
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"。指定 "true" 可在连接代理的每次调用时重新获取事务性连接；如果在 JBoss 中跨事务边界持有连接句柄，则建议采用此设置。

items.source:
The effect of this setting is similar to the
"hibernate.connection.release_mode" value "after_statement".
items.translation: 此设置的效果与 `"hibernate.connection.release_mode"` 值为 `"after_statement"` 类似。

items.source: Wraps the given Connection with a proxy that delegates every method call to it but delegates close() calls to DataSourceUtils.
items.translation: 将给定的 Connection 包装为代理，该代理将所有方法调用委托给它，但将 `close()` 调用委托给 DataSourceUtils。

items.source: targetDataSource - the target DataSource
items.translation: targetDataSource - 目标 DataSource

items.source: targetDataSource - the DataSource that the Connection came from
items.translation: targetDataSource - 连接来源的 DataSource

items.source: a transactional Connection if any, a new one else
items.translation: 如果有事务性连接，则使用该连接，否则创建一个新的连接。

items.source:
The returned Connection handle implements the ConnectionProxy interface,
allowing to retrieve the underlying target Connection.
items.translation: 返回的 Connection 句柄实现了 ConnectionProxy 接口，允许获取底层的目标 Connection。

items.source:
Delegates to DataSourceUtils for automatically participating in Spring-managed
transactions.
items.translation: 委托给 DataSourceUtils 以自动参与 Spring 管理的交易。

items.source:
Specify whether to obtain the transactional target Connection lazily on
actual data access.
items.translation: 指定是否在真正进行数据访问时懒式获取事务目标 Connection。

items.source:
Specify whether to reobtain the target Connection for each operation
performed within a transaction.
items.translation: 指定是否在每个事务内执行的操作中重新获取目标连接。

items.source:
Determine whether to obtain a fixed target Connection for the proxy
or to reobtain the target Connection for each operation.
items.translation: 确定是为代理获取固定的目标连接，还是为每个操作重新获取目标连接。

items.translation: `getConnection` 接口 `DataSource`
